findings.text: the new s2 comment links /nova/evidence/fragments/kernel-compile-barrier/variadic-split.html#variadic-split, and the file exists in no commit of the plan's own checkout working tree and only on the unmerged variadic-split branch; its own summary (13/13 numeric tests, 305,139 instructions against a 402,141 base, 251.134514 s cold against a 133.418724 s limit) is therefore recorded nowhere a reader of the live plan can open, and the plan already carries a correcting comment (plan.html:162) saying that same path does not exist yet and is owed by the node

findings.reason: a worker can satisfy clause (1) for three rows and must then either invent a different measure for the fourth or declare the clause unmet, and the plan should instead say what is measured for the negative-control row.
findings.text: §6 clause (1) requires, "for each of the four rows, the first intermediate quantity at which main departs from the pinned copy is named, with the commit that introduced it", but one of the four named rows is test_truncated_tangent_fails_identity[edge_terms], a negative control that fails because the truncated tangent still matches within SCAN_TOLERANCE (tests/biot/test_edge_term_tangents.py:324-336 asserts subject > 1e-9); there is no departure from the pinned copy to locate for that row, so clause (1) names no producible measure for it

findings.reason: clause (1) asks the worker to name the commit that introduced each departure; a background claim narrowing the candidates to four invites a bisect that stops at the wrong commit or names one that cannot account for the edge rows, which is the whole object of the section.
findings.text: §6 states "Four later commits changed the kernel on purpose: 3a147537a, ffcbcb535, da28fc4e5 and cb42f656f", but `git rev-list --no-merges --full-history 716d859f0..00ec05512 -- nova/biot/polygonanalytic.py` returns 16 non-merge commits in the pin-to-failing-base range (43 further commits including merges), among them 6d14132d2 (preserve edge tangent arithmetic order), 95044c7f6 and 79b6e772a (differentiate polygon edge reductions and the near-collinear edge logarithm) and 8bb3910cd (composed corner arsinh remainder), each of which can move an edge-tangent departure, so the stated candidate set is both incomplete and presented as exhaustive

findings.reason: the sentence tells a reader those files are covered by a byte-identity check that the plan elsewhere limits to named jet fixtures, so it understates real unguarded scope and would keep a coordinator from deciding whether the gap is acceptable or needs a gate.
findings.text: §2 now says the read, bank and tracked-read test files "are run by no gate in this plan. Clause (1) stands in for them: the point jet they reach must return the base's bytes", but clause (1) is stated as judged "on the 10,000-point polygon and filament jet identity sets", and the same done-when later says explicitly "Clause (1) is judged on its own named sets, the 10,000-point polygon and filament jets, not on these rows"; those identity sets are not the code paths tests/test_tracked_read.py, tests/test_bank_newton_step.py and tests/test_support_read.py exercise, so the substitute asserted is not the measure the clause actually provides
